info.name: Instagram - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
A terminal-inspired Instagram skin. 

Dark green translucent feed cards and navigation, frosted panels, readable near-opaque menus and dialogs, green action controls, terminal font fallbacks, logo underglow, and coordinated scrollbars. Native Instagram theme variables extend the palette into profiles, Explore, Reels, search, messaging, settings and other screens that use those variables. Photo and video content retains its natural colors.
